caveats: RNAformer is a published pretrained model (its own learned weights), NOT trained on our data; pure CPU inference, no training performed here.
Sequences are length <= 500 (all validation seqs length 135), within RNAformer max_len.
P_pair uses marginal BPP (sum over partners), a continuous score richer than the dot-bracket binary used by classical baselines.

point_gain_vs_ours.note: point difference of study-macro AUPRC (our structure-aware classifier minus RNAformer)

protocol.P_pair: sum_j BPP[i,j] (marginal base-pair probability) from RNAformer sigmoid(logits[0,:,:,-1])
protocol.metric: study-macro AUPRC (mean over studies of per-study AP)
protocol.reference: M. Becker et al., Predicting RNA secondary structure by learning unrolled algorithms, Nature Machine Intelligence 2023

rnaformer.note: Published pretrained DL folding model; untrained in-silico mutagenesis on our data
